data_dictionary.indicator_name: Low-income population share in 500 m catchment (CT area-weighted estimate)
data_dictionary.definition: sum_t(area(buffer intersect CT_t)/area(CT_t) * LIM_AT_count_t) / sum_t(area(buffer intersect CT_t)/area(CT_t) * total_population_t)
data_dictionary.spatial_scope: 500 m continuous corridor buffer; CT area weighting; corridor 01 trial geometry only
data_dictionary.population_scope: LIM-AT private-household numerator / all Census residents denominator; custom proxy, not official prevalence
data_dictionary.technology_dependence: none in Census counts; catchment assumptions apply
data_dictionary.potential_overlap: population coverage; other resident equity indicators
data_dictionary.notes: v0.5: 24/24 provisional CT area-weighted estimates. Custom LIM characteristic 326 / all residents characteristic 1; income reference 2020, geography/population 2021; not official LIM prevalence. Uniform within-CT density. Two positive-population CTs (5350205.00, 5350006.00) and all their DAs have suppressed LIM counts. User-authorized same-Toronto complete CT rate median (583 peers) times CT population supplies separate scenario counts; mean sensitivity retained. Original suppressed source cells stay blank. Corridors 3,8,21 include these replacements. Source-complete catchments: 21; constructed scenario coverage: 24. Seven 2021 RNF shortest-road proxies plus seventeen prior named-road proxies; no approved future alignment or station catchment claim. Geographic, vintage and baseline reviews remain pending.
data_dictionary.missing_data_policy: Complete DA sum, otherwise same-CSD complete CT rate median; suppressed_CT_imputed; mean sensitivity
